candidate.core_job: Show households and microbusinesses how current March 2027 deadline versus proposed December extension could alter contract review and supplier-choice preparation
candidate.target_customer: Italian electricity customer support organizations and microbusiness advisers
candidate.product_mechanism: Manual existing contract and energy use figures, opt-in/customer status and the two alternative end dates, with nonbinding scenario label, to produce a reminder/notice checklist and hypothetical bill exposure
candidate.why_now: ANSA reports Italian ministry MASE studying extension of gradual electricity protections from 31 March to 31 December 2027 for small businesses and households. NOT approved law. Conditional scenario for retailers' notice/choice timeline and business transition cases; exclude automated official tariff selection and refrain from treating extension as enacted.
candidate.before_state: Consumers struggle to distinguish announced ministry study from current legally binding contract transition
candidate.after_state: Separate current rules from proposed extension, document customer information steps without assuming the extension passed
candidate.merge_note: Bu girdi diğer 166 kayıtla müşteri+iş+mekanizma temelinde karşılaştırıldı; doğrudan semantik mükerrer bulunmadı. Rakip/doğrulama hükmü değildir.
candidate.source_evidence_caveat: Kaynak URL'leri ve why_now gözlemleri Discovery'den devralındı. Bu Merge aşaması yeni bir kaynak okuyup page_read kanıtı üretmez.
